acceptanceCriteria: An edit to a spec pinned by a use-case contract receipt that does not touch the receipt's claimed sections no longer fails TestUCV0ProfileMigration, or the failure names the exact repin command.
Two open PRs that both edit docs/specs/daily-change-evidence-workflow-v0.md no longer force each other to regenerate conformance/use-cases-v0 receipts and ledger.json after every merge.
The receipt still detects a substantive change to the evidence it attests; the chosen binding is recorded in the use-case conformance spec and BUILD-LOG.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 while fixing CI on PRs #127, #130 and #133. conformance/use-cases-v0/receipts/*/contract.json pins the whole-file sha256 of docs/specs/daily-change-evidence-workflow-v0.md, and implementation.json pins source files such as cmd/corvint/local_completion.go; ledger.json pins each receipt's digest. Any edit to those files fails TestUCV0ProfileMigration (subject-digest-mismatch, conformance/use-cases-v0/main.go:363) even when the attested behaviour is unchanged, and repositoryRevision is only pattern-checked (:332). Every DCW-editing PR must repin, and each merge forces the remaining PRs to repin again. A mechanical repin (recompute subject digests, set repositoryRevision to HEAD, update ledger digests) was needed on four branches. Options: bind to requirement IDs or section digests, or ship a repin make target with a clear failure fix line.
title: conformance: use-case receipts pin whole-file digests, so every DCW spec edit forces a repin
